subject: Joint onramp pilot: Redwood + Observify + Datadog + Grafana
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha@observify.com>, Alex Cho <acho@datadoghq.com>, Jenna Park <jenna@grafana.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Joint onramp pilot: Redwood + Observify + Datadog + Grafana

Hi Samantha / Alex / Jenna —

Thanks again for the quick call last week. We’d like to propose a short, focused onramp pilot to validate an Observability integration that: 1) plugs Observify’s log/trace enrichment into Redwood’s OTLP relay, 2) verifies Datadog and Grafana ingestion flows from the relay, and 3) builds a joint marketplace listing/technical certification path.

Proposed scope (2–4 weeks):
- Week 1: Data model mapping & small-scale OTLP relay deployment in Redwood sandbox
- Week 2: Ingestion validation to Datadog + Grafana dashboards; basic alerting smoke tests
- Week 3: Security/compliance checklist (SOC2 evidence, data retention settings) and draft MAP
- Week 4: Marketplace/partner onboarding checklist + SOW template for pilot expansion

Deliverables: MAP v0, short SOW, certificate checklist, test dashboards.

Could you confirm technical contacts and whether Observify has a sample dataset we can use? I’m attaching a draft MAP template and a proposed certification checklist to speed the conversation.

Available kickoff window: Nov 16–19 (US PST). If those dates don’t work we can push to week of Nov 23.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

—
Nikhil Sharma
Head of Partnerships (integrations)
Redwood Inference
nikhil@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0183

Attachments: redwood-map-draft-v1.xlsx, cert-checklist-observability.pdf

From: Samantha Reed <samantha@observify.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Cho <acho@datadoghq.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 12:07:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Joint onramp pilot: Redwood + Observify + Datadog + Grafana

Hi Nikhil —

Appreciate the clear plan. Observify is very interested. Quick answers:
- Tech leads: me (PM) and I’ll loop in Ravi Patel (ravi@observify.com) as the engineering lead for the connector.
- Sample data: yes, we can provide two sanitized datasets (app logs + traces) in OTLP format.
- Compliance: we can share SOC2 summary and a data handling appendix.

I attached our connector proposal and a filled SOW template for your review. We’re good to kick the week of Nov 16 — Nov 17 looks best for our team.

Questions for Redwood: do you have a small sandbox relay we can use (no production keys), and will Datadog/Grafana partners require specific ingestion schemas?

Best,
Samantha Reed
Head of Product Partnerships
Observify
samantha@observify.com

Attachments: observify-connector-proposal.pdf, sow-template.docx

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Joint onramp pilot: Redwood + Observify + Datadog + Grafana

Marissa / Ben —

Looping you both in. Observify can provide OTLP samples and wants to kick Nov 17. We’ll need:
- A sandbox OTLP relay configured in our staging infra (no customer keys)
- A quick certification checklist for partners (security + ingestion schema)
- Point person for Datadog/Grafana ingestion verification and a rough estimate of effort and cost (engineering hours + any integration fees)

Marissa — can your team run the certification checklist and own the Datadog/Grafana verification?
Ben — can you surface contract/SOW redlines we should expect for a short pilot (NDA addendum, limited liability, data usage)?

I’ll coordinate call invites and send the MAP draft to Observify.

Thanks —
Nikhil

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FW: Joint onramp pilot: Redwood + Observify + Datadog + Grafana

On Wed, Nov 11, 2026 at 08:30 AM Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com> wrote:

> 
> Looping you both in. Observify can provide OTLP samples and wants to kick Nov 17. We’ll need:

> - A quick certification checklist for partners (security + ingestion schema)
> - Point person for Datadog/Grafana ingestion verification and a rough estimate of effort and cost (engineering hours + any integration fees)

Thanks Nikhil — happy to take this on. High-level plan from infra/PD: 
- I’ll provision a scoped relay instance in staging (target: Nov 16) and hand it to Ravi.
- QC checklist: I attached our partner cert checklist (lightweight) and a short runbook for validating Datadog/Grafana ingestion.
- Est effort: ~2 engineer-days to validate ingestion to both endpoints + 1 day to assemble test dashboards and alerts. Cost for pilot support: we’ll absorb infra hours; if Observify requests professional services beyond verification we’ll scope separately.

I recommend a 45-minute kickoff on Nov 17 (PST) to align owners and run through MAP.

—
Marissa Cole
Sr. Product Manager, Integrations
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments: cert-checklist-observability.pdf, datadog-grafana-runbook.md

From: Alex Cho <acho@datadoghq.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>, Samantha Reed <samantha@observify.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Joint onramp pilot: Redwood + Observify + Datadog + Grafana

Hi all —

Thanks for looping Datadog in. We’re supportive of a pilot; a few notes from our side:
- Ingestion schema: Datadog accepts OTLP natively — we’ll share a sample ingestion manifest and a lightweight validation script.
- Marketplace / co-sell: we can support a joint listing if the pilot completes basic security checks and a short integration guide is published (our marketplace team will need a 2-week lead).
- PR / co-marketing: open to a short joint blog + webinar after pilot success.

I’ll attach the ingestion manifest and a small validation script. Proposed cadence: Nov 17 kickoff; if successful, 2-week runway to prepare marketplace assets.

—
Alex Cho
Partner Solutions Engineer
Datadog
acho@datadoghq.com

Attachments: datadog-otlp-manifest.json, datadog-validate.sh

Action items before kickoff (owners):
- Observify (Samantha / Ravi): share OTLP sample datasets and any connector notes (due Nov 15)
- Redwood (Marissa): provision staging OTLP relay and share access (done Nov 16) — sample keys: STAGE-RELAY-XYZ (no production data)
